title: Damodar Vrata
subtitle: Śrī Chaitanya Gauḍīya Maṭha
description: Damodar Vrata — a themed treasury of teachings gathered by the Śrī Chaitanya Gauḍīya Maṭha.

articles.title: First Yaam - Shraddha
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: 3:22am to 5:46am. Chanting of the Holy Name Śrī Kṛṣṇa, completely, loudly in the company of devotees and without tenfold offences, which can bestow seven attainments— viz. cleansing of the mind-mirror, extinguishing of the forest fire of birth, death and threefold afflictions, bestowing eternal soothing benefit like moonlight, life of spiritual learning i.e. awakening of the real self, increasing of the ocean of bliss, bestowing at every step sweet taste of complete transcendental ambrosia, holy immersion of body-mind-real self—be supremely glorified.

lines: Ataeva namābhase sarva pāpa vinash āra samsara kshaya

blocks.text: Therefore, glow of the Holy Name can destroy all sins and also rescue us from earthly attachments.

lines: taṁ nirvyājam bhaja guṇa-nidhe pāvanaṁ pāvanānāṁ

blocks.text: That person is addressed as guṇa-nidhe (one who is richly endowed with good qualities), who has got the aptitude to utter without delay, the Holiest Divine Name ‘Krishna’, greatest Redeemer of all redeemers, with firm faith, without hypocrisy and with simple-heartedness. The votary should chant the Holy Name with firm faith that by serving Krishna one serves all there. We cannot serve our parents or relatives or other human beings or demigods or any other person or living beings without the service of Sri Krishna, this sort of firm faith should be there. So, why should we spoil our time? Without serving Krishna we cannot serve all. We should chant the Holy Name Without deceitfulness, without hypocrisy and immediately with simple heartedness. There should be frankness of heart, then we can get the grace of Supreme Lord, worship Him and do Harinam with these qualities. Why? By the glow of the Sun at dawn before Sun rises, all darkness is removed like that the glow of the holy name entering the cave of the heart will destroys all great sins and nescience.

lines: prathame prathama śloka bhaja kichu din,

blocks.text: By remembering Shikshashtaka, we can remember all the pastimes of RadhaKrishna of eight periods. Without following Shikshashtaka you cannot enter into the pastimes of Radhakrishna. You should follow the process. First you should give attention to the words of the first verse, and when you will be well-established then you have to practice the next verse and become eligible for next verse.

lines: chāri śloke kramaśaḥ bhajana pakkva kara,
paṣcam ślokete nija siddha deha vara

blocks.text: Without getting the realized self that is beyond this material plane, absolutely spiritual and transcendental, you cannot have contact with the transcendental Supreme Lord. By remaining with false ego, we cannot go there. ‘siddha deha vara’ is written in the 5thverse.

And if you want to get what our Guruvarga wants to give us, the highest prem, then you have to take shelter of Radharani. Our procedure is like this. Through Radharani you can go there. Radharani is also complete transcendental spiritual potency and we should be in a realized state as Her servant or maid servant whatever it may be.

lines: chaya śloka bhajite anartha dure gela,

blocks.text: How you can understand that you are entitled to get this realized form? When by doing Harinam if you are not getting ecstatic feelings ‘nayanam galad-ashru-dharaya vadanam gadgada-ruddhaya gira pulakair nicitam vapuh kada tava nama-grahane…..’ While doing Harinam no tears are coming and ecstatic feelings are not getting manifested then there must be some offences. By that you can understand whether you have attained realized state or not, whether you are entitled to enter into these pastimes i.e. transcendental pastimes.

lines: sāvdhāne krama dhara yadi siddhi cāo,
sādhura carita dekhi śuddha buddhi pāo,

blocks.text: Always you have to think about this. You have to remember, chant and speak about these things, then you can have entrance to the transcendental pastimes.

That sort of inspiration will come to us. All kinds of ulterior desires will be removed. All the desires for material piety and others, dharma, artha, money, fulfillment of desire and even desire for emancipation are obstacles and all these obstacles will be vanished. By remembrance of Shikshashtaka, you will get everything.

Chanting of the Holy Name Sree Krishna, completely, loudly in the company of devotees and without tenfold offences, which can bestow seven attainments—viz. cleansing of the mind-mirror, extinguishing of the forest fire of birth-death and threefold afflictions, bestowing eternal soothing benefit like moonlight, life of spiritual learning i.e. awakening of the real self, increasing of the ocean of bliss, bestowing at every step sweet taste of complete transcendental ambrosia, holy immersion of body-mind-real self—be supremely glorified.
Everything you will get by doing sankirtan.
Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakur has given us provision to remember Krishna’s pastimes along with Sri Shikshashtaka.
Siksataka Kirtan- 1
Meditation on Krishna’s awakening pastimes:

lines: nishanta kirtane kunja bhanga kare dhyan
krame krame citta lagane rasera vidhan

blocks.text: Mind is the cause of our bondage and is also the cause of liberation. By mind we do remembrance. If in mind you are thinking about material things while sitting here then you are in material world. But if sitting at home if you think of Krishna-seva, then you are in Krishna-seva. So, it is said to meditate on the pastimes of awakening of RadhaKrishna in the grove at the close of night. If you think, do some practice, then you will get the fruit. Without doing anything how you can get? Gradually you will get the taste of the transcendental bliss.

lines: rādhā-Krishnau satṛṣṇāv api nija-nija dhāmnyāpta talpau smarāmi

blocks.text: To awaken Radha Krishna at day break Vrindadevi sends Shuk-Sharika birds to sing and awaken RadhaKrishna. These are not ordinary birds. We have heard before, one who does not attain siddha-deha (realized form) cannot serve Krishna. So, they are all associates, not ordinary birds. Now we are doing the work of birds. Swamiji, you called us birds, you disregarded us? Actually, we are under the birds. They are beautifully singing Krishna’s glories. When Shuk sings more qualities of Krishna, devotees on behalf of Krishna are satisfied, but when female parrot Sharika sings glories of Radharani more than Krishna, the personal associates of Radharani become happy and Krishna’s associates’ heart sank. In this way, competition of singing continues. There is order that by force, by compulsion, by making loud noise of instruments waking up is not correct. By sweet words they should be woken up so that they open eyes by their own sweet will, so should be the singing. They have such melodious voice and so hearing their sweet songs in glories, Radharani opens Her eyes by Her own sweet will. Hearing glories over glories she feels happy and opens Her eyes. Along with Shuk-Sharika, even Gopis are singing kirtans in sweet voices and when Radharani wakes up Gopis worries are gone because their responsibility of service is over, it is now Radharani’s responsibility to awaken Krishna. Though Krishna is in front of Her, Radharani cannot wake Krishna up by shaking Him saying ‘get up, get up.’ Radharani is in difficulty as Krishna does not open His eyes. It is a pastime. There, sleep is not like Kumbhakarna’s sleep. That type of sleep is of tamo-guna. There is no existence of tri-guna—satva, raja and tama, everything is nirguna. In nirguna, Krishna is playing this pastime to give service to all. Krishna sees a female monkey by name Kakkhati. That monkey is also the personal associate of RadhaKrishna. She also has the desire to serve and Krishna is affectionate to His devotees, bhakta-vatsal, and does not lose sight of even smallest of the smallest sevak. Gopis do not give her permission because her voice is very harsh, not good, but she wants to serve. She has got the desire to serve. She is giving her sign to all the Gopis that you are unable to do, let me do my duty. They say, “No, your sound is very harsh.” So, she is disheartened. But Krishna wants to give her service. For Krishna her sound is sweet. We also have heard from our Gurudeva about one devotee, very devoted but whose voice was not good. Prabhupad says I want to hear from him. It is ok if voice is not good, if he has devotion then that is good. Devotees also have this kind of feeling.

Sakhis were forced to give permission to Kakkhati despite her harsh sound when their efforts were not producing results and it was getting late. She made her harsh screaming sound and Krishna woke up. There is so much convenience in Krishna-bhajan, He is bhakta-vatsal, He does not leave anyone. Here also, we are doing the activities of birds in a way. And the monkey, what she is doing is like the ringing of the bell ‘tong.. tong..’ and Krishna wakes. Therefore we are called birds, not even birds actually, we are under them, surrendered to them, they are not ordinary birds. It is not good to feel that we are disrespected by being called birds. Then finally RadhaKrishna wake up. Their sleep is not like ours that is out of tamo guna, it is for giving service to devotees in their pastime. They look at each other and go to their respective homes. Everything is transcendental, not like here that on amavasya day we will need a torch light to see.

lines: na tatra sūryo bhāti na candra-tārakaṁ
tam eva bhāntam anu bhāti sarvaṁ

blocks.text: “There (in the spiritual sky) the sun does not shine, nor does the moon, the stars or lightning as we know them, what to speak of ordinary fire. It is by the reflection of the spiritual sky’s effulgence that everything else gives light, and thus through its radiance this entire universe becomes luminous.”

The Sun, the moon and the stars actually illuminate through the light of Krishna. He performed wonderful pastimes to give His service to all. They went to their respective homes and slept in their beds.
Lila Kirtan 1

lines: nija nija gṛhe gelā, nibhṛte śayana kailā
ei līlā smaro āra gāo kṛṣṇa-nāma,

articles.title: Second Yaam - Sadhu Sange Anartha Nivritti
articles.author: Sree Chaitanya Gaudiya Math
articles.excerpt: 5:46am to 8:10am. O Supreme Lord! Your Holy Name bestows all kinds of eternal welfare to the conditioned souls. For that reason, your Holy Names have no direct or indirect connection with the non-eternal material world. These Holy Names have descended in this world. Supreme Lord has bestowed all powers to His Names and no restriction is imposed to utter the Holy Names. No restriction of time, space— rules and regulations, for utterance and remembrance of the Holy Names. O Lord! You are so merciful, out of compassion you have made easy for the conditioned souls to remember and chant Holy Names, but due to my tenfold offences and my greatest misfortune I have got no liking for Holy Name which has been made so easily obtainable.

blocks.text: Second Period of Devotional Practice (2nd Yama Sadhana)
Morning Bhajan—Association of devotee-sadhus, taking shelter of a pure devotee—bona fide Guru (Spiritual Guide), devotional practice as per direction of Guru and removal of ulterior desires

“O Supreme Lord! Your Holy Name can bestow all kinds of eternal welfare to the conditioned souls. You have Your Principal Names like Krishna, Govinda, Gopinath, etc. You manifest in this world by Your Name and invest all the powers in Your Names. To remember the Names and chant the Names no restrictions have been imposed, no rules and regulations are been imposed. One can chant Your Name any time, in any circumstance and any place. O Lord! You are so merciful to the conditioned souls i.e. out of compassion you have made easy for the conditioned souls to remember and chant Holy Names, but due to my tenfold offenses and my greatest misfortune I have got no liking for Holy Name which has been made so easily obtainable.”

Our Param Gurudeva, Srila Prabhupad, through one sub-servitor gave teaching. He served Srila Prabhupad very nicely, in Chaitanya Math. Though he was a Brahmachari, all would address him Sajjanananda Maharaj. After serving for ten years, he placed a question before Srila Prabhupad, “Guruji, I did service to you for ten years, but I have got nothing.” We also have such questions within us but we do not have that courage to ask them to Gurudev. We feel shy to put such questions. Everyone wished to hear the answer, as it was the question of all of us which he has placed. Everyone’s ears got sharpened and they came to listen to the answer. In reply, his Gurudeva, our Param Gurudeva, Bhakti Siddhant Saraswati Goswami Thakur asked, “Have you got Harinama?”
Sajjanananda Maharaj, “Yes, I Have.”
“Then what is left to get? Name is Named, the Lord.”

This knowledge is absent. Lord’s Name, Form and Deity form are one and the same, there is no difference. Name, form, qualities, pastimes, associates, all are one. Supreme Lord first manifests as Name, and when Name is practiced without any kind of offenses then form, qualities, pastimes, they manifest in that sequence, they are not different. You have chanted the Name and you did not get the association of Lord, it is not like that. Is there any hindrance? To give an example, there is a glass-bottle with honey inside and is corked. Seeing the honey inside, if one lick it, will it taste sweet?
“I have tasted honey; it is not sweet.
“Is it bitter?”
“No, it is not bitter.”
“Is it sour?”
“No, it does not have any taste.”

What will be the taste of glass? Similarly, we try to fulfill our ulterior motives by performing Harinam. The real connection with Lord’s Name does not get established. Even by slightest of connection with the Name, by the glow of the Holy Name (Namabhas), Ajamila got liberated, not only all his sins got destroyed; Namabhas also gave him liberation. It was Sanket Namabhas, inferior Namabhas (nimnakoti). There complete Harinam did not occur. Offences to Holy Name (Nama-aparadha) bestow material fruits. Severe offences to the Holy Name like blaspheming Vishnu, Vaishnavas and Guru will lead to hell and there will be no benefit. Ordinary offences to Holy Name can give material fruits.

lines: khāite śuīte yathā tathā nāma laya,

blocks.text: One should chant the Holy Name all the time even while eating and resting. One who chants like this will attain all the perfections. We have got the association of sadhus and the birth in this special Kaliyuga of 7th Manavantara—the opportunity to easily get the Transcendental Divine Love (Prem). If we do not utilize it properly then we will lose this opportunity. Is such a person intelligent? No, He is foolish indeed.
We have to remember whatever Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakur has said. We should go through the whole Bhajana Rahasya.

lines: anya parve ruchi nāhi haya pravartana,

blocks.text: A Pure devotee who has got one-pointed devotion to Lord has got liking only to perform devotion of chanting and remembering Sri Krishna. By Kirtan all other limbs of devotion are performed, no process of devotion remains left out. But if one understands Kirtan as an ordinary material sound then it will not work. In the commentary of the first verse of Sri Chaitanya Charitamrta, at the beginning on the top, our Srila Prabhupada did not write ‘All Glories to Sri Sri Guru Gauranga’, instead, he wrote ‘Sri Krishna Kirtanaya Namah.’ Can one offer obeisance to Kirtan? We can understand, ‘Sri Krishnaya Namah, Sri Ramaya Namah’ where obeisance is offered to a Personality. But Srila Prabhupad wrote, ‘Sri Krishna Kirtanaya Namah’ i.e. obeisance to Sri Krishna Kirtan. Sri Krishna Kirtan and Sri Krishna both are one, to give this teaching. First, he wrote ‘Sri Krishna Kirtanaya Namah’. Who can perform Sri Krishna Kirtan? The person who has the realization that the Name and the Named are non-different can only perform Krishna Kirtan. All Glories to Sri Gurudev who can perform Sri Krishna Kirtan!! I cannot do, my Gurudeva can do. An ignorant person like me, how can I do?

Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu is Sri Krishna Sankirtana Vigraha (the personified form of Sri Krishna Sankirtan). We give glories to Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu. Srila Prabhupad did not write ‘Sri Sri Guru Gaurang Jayata’. In the commentary of the first verse ‘ceto darpana marjanam…’, Srila Prabhupad wrote about the nine forms of devotion mentioned by Prahlad Maharaj. There are infinite number of devotional practices out of which 64 limbs of devotion are mentioned in Bhakti-rasamrita-sindhu. Ah!! How can one understand the infinite number of devotional practices? The permutation and combination of 64 kinds of devotional forms make an infinite types of devotional forms. Among these infinite kinds of devotional practices, Sri Krishna Kirtan is the topmost, Supreme-most, not just Supreme, Supreme-most, not superlative, double superlative. Kirtan leads to remembrance (Smaran) and also hearing (sravan). So, by Kirtan, all other devotional practices are automatically done.

A Pure devotee who has got one-pointed devotion to Lord has got liking only to perform devotion of chanting and remembering Sri Krishna. One who is not fully fixed in devotion, he may get some temporary feelings for some time. These temporary feelings do not represent the state of advanced stage of devotion (bhava). When these feelings become permanent then that state is called sthayi-bhava — the advanced stage with fixed attachment. When one will be fixed in that permanent mood then one will do all services from the core of the heart with great attachment. At present we are not in that state, we have not realized our relation with Sri Krishna. We may feel devotional practices as compulsion, have to do types. We may feel, “Today body is not well so service is not possible, will see later.” We are caught up in the activities of the body. But one who is established in bhajan, even while he is resting he will think only about that. Thinking about the body all the time if one dies, he will get another body, what else will happen? This is not intelligence.
Bhaktivinoda Thakur has written,
According to their delightful relation, there is inspiration of gradual development of love. Devoted devotee’s all actions are inspired by pure love originating from delightful relation.

How to know a pure devotee? He will perform activities inspired by pure love originating from the heart, from delightful relation (ragodita). There is no need of any persuasion. He thinks, “Now I have to fan Them, I should offer Them a glass of water, I should be giving Them rest”. All time his attention is on service and so no mistakes occur. Even if the master does not ask for the service, understanding his internal mood he serves him. Many a times, out of affection and love, he serves even going against the instructions of the master. Not following someone is considered as an offense, but for service he is ready to accept the offenses also. For instance, crossing over someone or even crossing over shadow of someone is considered as an offence, but Govinda served Mahaprabhu by crossing over His transcendental body. While he was serving, Mahaprabhu asked, “You are still here? You have not gone for Prasadam? Why?”
Govinda, “How shall I go?”
Mahaprabhu, “How did you come?”
Govinda, “I came to serve you but now I cannot cross You for myself (to eat).”
Bhaktivinoda Thakur further says,

lines: sarva tyāga karile o chārā sukaṭhina,

blocks.text: We can give up everything but to give up the desire for prestige, name and fame is very difficult. The wise votary who wants development of pure devotion must be very careful in regard to this.

Till this desire of name and fame is given up, devotion is not possible. The desire for name and fame is compared to pig’s stool, why? Because there is false pride in it which results in the possibility of committing offences to Vaishnavas and Guru. If one has lusty desires, like interest in women, he thinks, “I performed abominable act”. There will be a feeling of humility in his heart but for a person who has the desire for name and fame does not have humility, there is false pride because of which he may commit offenses to Vishnu, Vaishnavas and Guru. Therefore, it is called pig’s stool. Once in our Kolkata Math, Srila Sridhar Deva Goswami Maharaj spoke like this. One listener felt pained to hear this, he came to Srila Maharaj and told, “Your instruction about giving up desire for gold, women, name and fame (kanaka-kamini-pratistha) is good, but you used such a bad word as ‘pig’s stool’ for the desire for name and fame. Pig feeds on stool, and you said ‘pig’s stool’ which means ‘stool’s stool’. Why have you used such a bad word?”
Srila Maharaj replied, “I did not find any word worse than this, so I used that word. If there was any word more badly than this then I would have used that”. Ha Ha!!

lines: ei rūpe kīrtana smaraṇa jei kare,

blocks.text: The votary who wants spontaneous loving devotion (Raga-bhakti) should do Harinam giving up all ulterior desires in the morning, midnight, mid-day and in the evening, i.e.— always. With this devoutness when the said votary performs ‘Kirtan’ and ‘Smaran’, he will get the grace of Krishna soon and will be able to get the highest objective by which he will be actually emancipated from all attachments.

lines: śraddhā kari’ sādhu sange kṛṣṇa-nāma laye,

blocks.text: The aspirant should utter the Name of Krishna in the company of bona fide sadhus with firm faith, then all ulterior desires will be removed and he will get permanent fixation of the mind to the object of worship. We are to think about the second period of eternal pastimes of RadhaKrishna in the morning. By thinking, only by thinking, we can get development of pure divine love.

Whatever devotional practices we do, we should do them by praying for the grace of Guru, Vaishnava and Bhagavan. Vaishnavas pray for grace before and after Kirtan and Harikatha. Somebody might say, “Why to give so much time?” It is not a waste of time, without their grace no service is possible. Service is not possible by speaking something by own capability. So, here too, for remembering the pastimes of Sri Sri RadhaKrishna, we have to pray for the grace of Guru, Vaishnavas and Sri Sri Radha Krishna.
Siksataka Kirtan 2
Morning pastimes of RadhaKrishna

lines: susnātaṁ kṛta-bhojanaṁ saha-caraistaṁ cātha tāṁ cāśrye

blocks.text: In the morning, Radharani after taking bath dresses Herself in beautiful clothes for Krishna’s happiness and wearing Krishna’s favorite ornaments goes to the house of Nanda Maharaj (Nandgram) from Javat. He does everything for Krishna’s pleasure; this is detachment. As much attachment one has to Krishna that much detachment he has from the world. Radharani has the topmost renunciation (vairagya) because She has topmost attachment (sarvottam-asakti) to Krishna. She does everything for Krishna’s pleasure. So, by Her grace or the grace of Her expansions—the gopis, we can get that mood, not by our own efforts.

In this special Kaliyuga, we have got the good fortune to take shelter of Srila Prabhupad’s preceptorial channel. In this lineage we are bestowed the opportunity to serve in most sublime and radiant mellow of conjugal love. Those who have taken Sanyas, in their mantras (Sanyas-mantra), there are prayers for getting the conjugal love (Gopi-bhav) but it has to be accepted fully. If it is not accepted, not paid attention to, then it is our misfortune.

Yashoda Mata calls Radharani to come and cook thinking if Krishna eats the food prepared by Radharani, He will have a long life. She considers Krishna as her child, does not consider Him as Supreme Lord, and Krishna likes this. He wants such love; Krishna is the object of all love. The love of Vraja-vasi is not confined to any rules and regulations (vidhi). Yashoda Devi can cook herself, but still she calls Radharani. She thinks, “By eating the food prepared by Radharani, my child’s life will increase”. We may go to Yashoda Mata and tell her, “Yashoda Devi, you have less (or no) intelligence. Krishna is Supreme Lord Himself, Lord of Infinite Universes, Vaikunthas. You wish to increase His life?”

If you do such a foolish act then you will not get Vraja-prema and will remain in this material world bound by the rules and regulations only (vidhi marg bhakti). Yashoda Devi is in Vraja-bhava—mood of Vraja, how sweet it is! Radharani comes with Her sakhis. Radharani has Her attention to all. Radharani is just like Krishna, if Krishna has His attention on all, She also has Her attention on all. Radharani is even more magnanimous. Radharani thinks of the eternal welfare of all. When She sees some sakhi’s eagerness in service, She will call her and give her service. But eagerness for service should be there inside. After cooking and offering, She accepts the remnants of Krishna lovingly and the gopis also accept. This is the pastime of Radharani.

Through this pastime, it is shown that cooking for our object of worship with relation is also service. We may say, “Did we come to cook? Do you know from which family I have come to? Asking me to cook? Asking me to wash vessels?” These are Lord’s vessels, cooking is for the Supreme Lord. If you have no desire to cook for the Lord, how devotion is possible? What is the meaning of Devotion? All senses and sense objects have to be engaged in the service of the Lord, naturally, they will be engaged.

Once in our Sarbhoga Gaudiya Math such an instance had happened. I went there. One devotee approached me. I asked, “What is the matter?” There were some 4-5 devotees in Math. Not many outside devotees come to Math. That devotee said, “All the time I go for collections. I have become dead because of my continuous engagement in the collection. You people do not see.”
I replied, “Is it?”

Devotee, “Yes. And this man is performing worship of deities day in and day out and he is dead because of his continuous engagement there. This man is dead because of his continuous engagement in cooking and this man is dead because of washing vessels all the time. This is small math, you do not notice. We have to hire someone to help, a person for collecting donations, another person for cooking, another for cleaning vessels, yet another for performing worship of deities.”

What will we do? We will be free all the time so we will eat and sleep and spoil our whole life. What is this? Is this life? Actually, one person can do the service of five persons, if he desires. Will anybody die because of performing service? Why will he die? Instead, one will be saved by doing more service.
So here we have to see the ideal of Radharani, like this. Just reading will not do.

Does Krishna sleep like an ordinary person? There everything is pastimes. We may think, “Oh! Krishna also sleeps like us”. It is not so. There is no existence of sleep there like what we have here. It is the pastime to give service to the devotees. He wants to give service to His friends, to Yashoda Mata, Paurnamasi and others. There it is not like ours where after getting engaged in materialist activities all the time we fall asleep while listening to Harikatha.

Krishna wakes up in the morning, Nanda Maharaj and Yashoda Maiyya are happy. They have pure parental affection; Krishna is very pleased with that. They consider Him as their friend, son, Lord of their heart. He then goes for milking the cows. Why milk the cows? Just by the sight of Krishna milk flows from their breasts, no need of force. Krishna touches the cows and the cows are pleased. Then He takes bath with friends and then sits for breakfast together with friends; Yashoda Mata serves them. We may think that it is good to become sakha (friend of Krishna) because we can freely roam around with Krishna. Yashoda Mata and others will cook and we will eat without doing anything. We may think that the mood of friendship is good! Is it not so?
Lila Kirtan 2

lines: kṛṣṇa nidrā porihori’, goṣthe go-dohana kori’,
ei līlā cintā koro, nāma-preme goro-goro,
ei līlā cinto āra koro saṅkīrtana

articles.title: Third Yaam - Nistha
articles.author: Sree Chaitanya Gaudiya Math
articles.excerpt: 8:10am to 10:34am. The aspirant who is more humbler than a blade of grass, more forbearing than tree and who is completely devoid of desire for getting respect from others but giving due respect to all is eligible for doing Hari-kīrtan always.

blocks.text: Third Period of devotional practice (Purvahna-kaliya Bhajan — forenoon worship). Fixation of mind on the object of worship
When all the desires got removed then we can concentrate our mind on the object of worship. That sort of fixation of mind is called nishta.
Who is competent or eligible to do Harinam without offences? What is the way of doing Harinam? For this Chaitanya Mahaprabhu has taught us in the third verse:

lines: tṛṇād api sunīcena taror iva sahiṣṇunā

blocks.text: The person entitled to do Nāma Saṇkīrtan—the procedure of doing Harinām, is ascertained in the third verse of Shikshastaka. The aspirant who is more humbler than a blade of grass, more forbearing than tree and who is completely devoid of desire for getting respect from others but giving due respect to all is eligible for doing Harikīrtan always.

Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu addressing Swarupa damodar and Ray Ramanand has said, “Hear about the scriptural verse expressing the characteristics of how to do Harinam by which pure devotional love can be manifested. A good person considers himself more abominable than a blade of grass. When there is any sort of pride then there is chance of occurrence of offence. In this material world even a blade of grass has ego. When goat, cow, keep their feet on the grass, it bends. When they lift their feet, it stands up. The blade of grass wants to declare to the world that it is of this world. So not that kind of humbleness. It is indicative of the mood that I am of the world. Till such ego is there, one cannot become humbler than a blade grass. So we should give up all worldly pride. Until we have any sort of material ego, there will be every possibility of committing offence.

lines: vṛkṣa yena kāṭileha kichu nā bolaya
śukāyiā mailea kāre pānī nā māgaya

blocks.text: One who has got the quality of forbearance in two ways—like the tree, in spite of being loped, does not say anything but tolerates and has no aptitude to give trouble to anybody for it’s own sake for getting water, i.e. for sacrificing it’s own interest to fulfil the desire of others who seeks it’s help.

lines: yei ye māgaye, tāre deya āpana-dhana

blocks.text: If someone cut its branches, it gives him its own wealth. Own wealth means shelter, protection from Sun, rain and heat. It seems impossible for the conditioned souls of this world to have such forbearance. We may say, “He gives so much of troubles, how can I tolerate?” If you do not tolerate then how you will do Harinam? The tree, even if does not get any water, will not disturb any person. But it gives its own benefit to all. A person who has loped its branches, if he comes, we may say just go go go, but it gives shelter from the rays of the Sun and rains, it does not ignore that person. We cannot think of such tolerance in this world. How can we do Harinam?

Vaishnava should not have any mundane ego, false ego of this world. He gives respect to all human beings. Even if a person is bad, a Vaishnava gives respect to him thinking his object of worship Supreme Lord is residing in his heart. In that consideration, Vaishnava gives respect to all. Person may be rogue, very bad but Supreme Lord is residing in his heart. A Vaishnava respects everyone without desiring any respect from others. Conditioned souls of this world cannot do so. Even after listening to such teachings, if anybody says something bad, we will be ready to slap him.
Siksataka Kirtan 3

blocks.text: Forenoon pastimes of Sri RadhaKrishna are as follows:
While doing Harinam you should think about this, then your mind will be sanctified and all these pastimes will be revealed in your heart.

Krishna, after taking break-fast, goes to forest with cows and cowherd boys. Nanda Maharaj, Yashoda Devi and all the residents of Vraja, their life is going; they have more love for Krishna than their life! As He has to graze the cows and calves, so they cannot stop Him. They are following Him as long as they can see Him. When they cannot see Him, they feel disappointed and return. They feel separation from Krishna. Where there is love there is separation, they cannot tolerate even little separation. Desiring association of Radharani, Krishna is wandering with cowherd boys.

Radharani is waiting for Krishna at Radhakunda. Being attracted by pure devotion of Radharani, Krishna desires to go there. He has given satisfaction to the cows and cowherd boys. Whiling moving, they are getting love from Krishna and they are also loving Him. They perform many pastimes there. Krishna likes to serve cows. Krishna then says them, “You people stay here for some time. I will roam around for some time and will come back.”
Cowherd boys, “Kanaiya, where are you going?”
Krishna, “We will talk later, after I come back. I will come back and stay here with all of you.”

By convincing them Krishna goes at Radhakunda to meet Radharani. The cowherd boys do not have eligibility to go there. Now their life has gone, what can they do? In this manner I remember such Krishna.

What is the condition of Radharani here? She is already informed about Krishna’s going to forest with calves or cows. She is so much eager to go there to meet Krishna. She thinks, “I am to go there. How can I go?” She is in Her husband’s place, actually, husband is Supreme Lord Sri Krishna only but externally They are enacting some pastimes in which She has to meet Him with some restriction. She is very eager to meet Krishna. Nobody will allow Her to go to meet Sri Krishna and serve Him. Her mother-in-law, Jatila, is very strict. She thinks, “How can She go anywhere without my permission?”

Krishna advises Radharani, “Why are you worried? You pray to your mother-in-law. If you say You are going to meet Me, desire to worship Me then she will not allow. You tell her that You want to worship Sun god. Then she will allow You.”
Household persons like worshiping the demi-gods so that they can get material benefits like wealth, son, wife etc. Radharani approached her mother-in-law, “I have got the desire to worship Sun god.”
Jatila, “Oh, that is good, good, good. Go and worship Sun god. It is beneficial.”

On the name of worshiping Sun god, She will meet Krishna and will worship Him. One messenger, a confident (sakhi, a gopi) is sent to know where She will go and meet Krishna. She is waiting anxiously for Her confident to come and give Her the message about Krishna. We have to remember such Radharani in the forenoon who is waiting with perturbation of heart to get the message.
Lila Kirtan 3

articles.title: Fourth Yaam - Ruchi
articles.author: Sree Chaitanya Gaudiya Math
articles.excerpt: 10:34am to 3:22pm. O Supreme Lord! I have got no desire for wealth, manpower or erudition (desire for deceitful Trivarga— worldly piety, money and lust or even to merge myself with the Impersonal Formless Brahma, i.e. ‘Mukti’— salvation, which is more deceitful). My only prayer is to get causeless one-pointed devotion to You.

blocks.text: Mid-day pastimes—Bhajan with taste

The true worshipper of Harinām has got no other desire except causeless devotion to Sri Krishna. If there are any other desires, then Harināma is not possible. Our Guruji used to explain this giving an example.

Medanipur District is a big District in Bengal. In those days, villagers used to fear to come to cities; city people are deceivers. But now villages have become more deceitful than city people. It was not like this before. One villager was in need of funds for his daughter’s marriage. He decided to sell some silver and gold jewelry he had. But there were no jewelry shops in that village. There are many jewelry shops in the city. So he took some three-four intelligent persons along with him and went to a Jeweler’s street in the city Medanipur. While he was searching for the shop where he can sell the jewelry, he had the fear of getting deceived. That time he came across a shop in which he saw a man sitting in an easy chair wearing Tulasi-mala in his neck with big-big Tulasi beads and chanting Harinām. He thought, “He seems to be a good person”. The shop owner’s servant invited them into the shop and enquired on how he could help them?
The villager asked, “Do you purchase jewels?”
The salesman said, “Yes, we deal in jewels. We purchase, make and sell jewels. What do you want?”
The villager, “I have some jewels which I want to sell as I am in need of money”.

The salesman said, “Okey”, and uttered, “Keshava.. Keshava”. He takes the name of the Lord. The owner of the shop who is sitting outside in the easy chair, listening to the salesman, started uttering, “Gopal.. Gopal” in response. Now after listening to them, there remained no doubt in the mind of the villagers of them being devotees. So they brought all the silver and gold jewelry out of the bag they carried. The salesman started weighing the jewelry and while doing so also he was uttering, “Hari Hari!! Hari Hari!!” After listening to him uttering so the owner, sitting outside, uttered, “Hara Hara!!”

So all the names they were uttering are Lord’s names only. But their intension of uttering those names was different. The servant, by uttering, “Keshav.. Keshav”, was asking the owner in code words ‘Ke-shaba’, the meaning of which in Bangla language is, “Who are these people? Are they known to you?”
The owner responded uttering, “Gopal.. Gopal”, meaning, “They belong to the class who take care of cows. They are foolish people.”
The man then asked, “Can I steal the gold?” by uttering, “Hari, Hari !!” Hari is one who snatches other’s belongings.
The owner then uttered, “Hara.. Hara!!” meaning, “As much as you like”.

Are these Lord’s Names? Their motive of uttering the Names of the Lord is not for calling the Supreme Lord. Chanting the Lord’s Name with other worldly motives is not Harinām. The purpose of chanting Lord’s Name should be to call the Lord. One who calls the Lord for Lord’s satisfaction attains the mercy of the Lord. The Lord’s Name manifests Himself. Therefore it is said the worshipper of Name has no ulterior motive than to get causeless one-pointed devotion to Lord.

lines: na dhanaṁ na janaṁ na sundarīṁ

blocks.text: O Supreme Lord, I have no desire for wealth, manpower or erudition or even liberation. My only prayer is to get causeless one-pointed uninterrupted devotion to You birth after birth. If there are ulterior motives then that will cause hindrance between Lord’s Name and the worshipper and one cannot chant Holy Name. Supreme Lord is Absolute whole. Western philosophers say, “Absolute is for Itself and by Itself.” We do not call ‘It God’, we call masculine God ‘He God’. We say, “Absolute is for Himself and by Himself”. So if one calls for Supreme Lord only, He will come. If one calls with worldly motives, then Maya will come, Supreme Lord will not come.

lines: gṛha dravya śiṣya paśu ādi dhana
stri putra dāsa dāsi kuṭumbādi jana

blocks.text: We accumulate wealth for worldly benefits and sense enjoyment. All these worldly things come under wealth—house, material things, making disciples for my convenience and sense-enjoyment, domestic animals, paddy-crops, so many. One who lives in Krishna’s family he thinks, “Krishna is my Master; I am his servant, my wife is Krishna’s maid servant, all servants of mine are Krishna’s servants, Krishna is the only Master, there is no reason for sense-enjoyment. I am of Krishna’s, Krishna is mine, everyone is in Krishna by Krishna and for Krishna. Wife, sons, daughters, servants, maid-servants, relatives, these are all worldly relations. When we pray for getting worldly things, we cannot chant Krishna’s Name.

lines: ei saba pāībāra āśā nāhi kari
śuddhabuddhi deha more kṛṣṇa kṛpā kari

blocks.text: Desire for erudition, material knowledge, kavya—book of verse relating to poetic drama, rhetoric art, poetical talent, for acquiring name and fame, all these relate to worldly matters. I do not desire to get these. This has to be spoken from the heart, just speaking from mouth will not do. So speak from the heart, “O Krishna, kindly bestow me pure devotion. I do not want any of those temporary things.” One who prays like this is the most intelligent of all.

Lord is the master of infinite universes, infinite Vaikuntha planets. Leaving such a great master of infinite universes is like begging for ten rupees from a so called rich man of this world? Krishna can give crores of rupees, and even more. It is foolish to beg for ten rupees. Lord is the master of infinite Brahmandas so when you become His, then you automatically become the master of infinite Brahmandas. So to ask for this and that from His is foolishness. One who does not have knowledge about the Supreme Lord (Bhagavat-tatva) begs for temporary benefits.

A devotee is very intelligent; he prays for pure devotion. He does not want anything other than pure devotion. Like Vitrasura, when Lord Sankarshan appeared before him and asked him, “What do you want? You want Dhruva’s position?”
Vitrasura, “No.”
The Lord, “Do you want the position of Brahma?”
“No.”
“Want to be emperor of this world?”
“No.”
“Want to rule lower planetary worlds?”
“No.”
“Take any of the eight mystic powers.”
“No, I do not want.”
“Take Liberation.”
“No, I do not want.”
“What do you want?”
“Except You and Your association, I do not want anything.”

So Lord’s devotee is niṣkāma—desire-less, but he is intelligent of all. Other than devotees all are fools; they beg for little things from the greatest master. If one follows a devotee, then he will get some intelligence.

lines: sei māne kṛṣṇe mora nāhi bhakti gandha

blocks.text: When there will be actual pure love, the votary will have the feeling of humbleness within his heart and he will admit that he has got not even a tinge of devotion.
Siksataka Kirtan 4

blocks.text: Indication of Midday Pastimes of RadhaKrishna
A hint has been given here about the mid-day pastimes of Sri RadhaKrishna.

During mid-day, by the meeting of Sri RadhaKrishna, all the ecstatic feelings of highest order including asṭasāttvik-vikār—eight principal ecstatic feelings, thirty three kinds of other subordinate ecstatic feelings— sancāri—all kinds of highest sweet inciting transcendental ecstatic feelings are manifested. The mid-day pastimes at Radhakunda are highest and holiest. How to realize it? Only by hearing about this pastime we cannot understand what this pastime is. We may think it something of this worldly novel, drama, etc. There should be desire to do Harinām to get a bonafide guru who has got the mantra through a bonafide preceptorial channel. After getting mantra, you have to practice it. To go to the Supreme Lord the first medium is sound. In this world sound, the characteristic of the sky, is the subtlest. The knowledge of spiritual world is manifested first through sound. This sound through which this spiritual knowledge gets manifested is not material sound, it is transcendental spiritual sound. Those words (Mantra) have to be received from the transcendental personality—receiving Mantras, receiving Harinām. And after receiving the Mantra, one has to perform sādhan according to their instructions. Everything is within the Name. The material sound which is said subtle is actually gross as compared to śabda-brahma—Harinām, the transcendental sound we receive from the pure devotee, sad-guru. Within the Name of the Lord, the form, qualities, pastimes, everything is there. Sri Jiva Goswami has written that first one should hear the Lord’s Names in order to purify the heart. First, one has to accept the Name from sad-guru. By your own efforts, by your gross mind and intelligence do not try to think about the form, qualities and pastimes of the Lord, it will not be of any benefit. In the Mantra received from sad-guru there is form, qualities, pastimes, everything is there. Finer than the transcendental sound is the form. Not the form like we see with our eyes.

Bilvamangal Thakur destroyed his eyes—the eyes which take us in different direction. Then with transcendental eyes, he saw the Lord. These material eyes are destroyed when pierced with a broom stick, so these are of what value? We cannot see Lord with our material eyes. When we chant Lord’s Name without offences, the heart will be purified and the form will manifest automatically. Have courage and patience. Artificially we should not think about the form of Supreme Lord. It is not material form that material mind can grasp it. Not possible. When the heart is cleansed then eligibility is attained to hear about the form; the form will be manifested. We cannot see Supreme Lord by our own efforts. By chanting Names, form which is more subtle, finer than sound will manifest. When form completely manifests, then even more finer than form, qualities manifest. Lord’s personal associates are not ordinary material world’s persons, they are transcendental, they are more subtle, they then manifest in the heart. And at the end, pastimes of the Lord will manifest which is the most finest.

When we haven’t got Lord’s Holy Name—the Mantra from sad-guru, how can we think about pastimes of the Lord? We think them as material world’s men-women relations like in novels. By that we will go to hell. Our relation to RadhaKrishna is not established yet. So we do not understand them. Intense greed is the only price to attain the real understanding and entrance into these pastimes.

There are eight principal ecstatic feelings, thirty-three kinds of other subordinate ecstatic feelings—sancāri—all kinds of highest sweet inciting transcendental ecstatic feelings are manifested in Radhakunda. In no other pastimes such excellent charmness of sweet ecstatic feelings can be found. Some extraordinary ecstatic feelings have been mentioned here. ‘Vamyā’—crookedness of prema, external expression of rudeness, harshness is there but inside actually just the reverse—which is inexplicable. ‘Utkaṇṭhā’—supreme eagerness to get contact with the object of love, which removes all kinds of restlessness but in this ecstatic feeling they have become externally too much restless. We have not experienced such feelings any time so how do we understand them? The shadow feelings like utkaṇṭhā and vamyā are sometime seen in worldly dealings, but there is a gulf of difference, like the difference between earth and sky between worldly activities and Lord’s pastimes.

By hearing jokes of the gopis RadhaKrishna get happiness. In addition to these, there are innumerable pastimes, viz. swinging ceremony of RadhaKrishna, pleasant strolling in the forest, water sports in ponds and rivers, stealing of flute and other transcendental amorous pastimes, drinking of sweet honey, worship of Sun God etc. Only gopis have eligibility in these pastimes. Gopis worship RadhaKrishna, arrange for their meeting. Devotees who in śānta, dāsya, sākhya and vātsalya rasa do not have eligibility to enter into these pastimes.
Lila Kirtan 4

articles.author: Sree Chaitanya Gaudiya Math
articles.excerpt: 3:22pm to 5:46pm. O Nandanandan, in spite of my being your eternal servant, due to predicament of my own deeds, I am drowned in the terrible ocean of births and deaths. Out of compassion kindly think me as dust particle of your Lotus Feet.

blocks.text: Afternoon worship—Attachment to Krishna

Now we have come up to the stage of attachment for the Lord. We first have to examine ourselves on whether we have got attachment to the Lord or not. Devotional service begins after we shall have the knowledge of our relation with Krishna. By forgetting Supreme Lord we have drowned in the terrible ocean of births and deaths. So we should pray to Supreme Lord; Lord is merciful. If you go to the conditioned souls of this world and request him to accept you as a servitor, he may not accept if it is not in his interest. But Supreme Lord Krishna is All Merciful. If you submit your prayer, ask Him to accept you as his servant, He will accept.

O Nandanandan, in spite of my being Your eternal servant, due to predicament of my own deeds, I am drowned in the terrible ocean of births and deaths. Out of compassion kindly think me as dust particle of your Lotus Feet.

In reality, we have no intelligence. This material world is like a dream. After 80 lakh births, we have got this human birth. Supreme Lord has given wisdom to understand what is good and what is bad. If we do not use the wisdom to perform devotion, then it is our misfortunate. We should pray to the Lord, “I have fallen in this material ocean of births and deaths. But You are merciful, please forgive all my offences and accept me as Your servant. You consider me as a particle of dust of Your Lotus Feet.”
Siksataka Kirtan 5

blocks.text: I remember such Srimati Radharani who has returned from Radhakunda to Javat in the afternoon and is engaged for preparing various good dishes of different names—‘Amritakeli’, ‘Karpurkeli’ etc. for presentation to beloved Sri Krishna. Radharani also takes bath nicely, dresses Herself with good garments, to satisfy Sri Krishna and very anxiously waits on the path for the return of Krishna from pasture and is extremely delighted to see the Lotus Face of Sri Krishna [It is to be very carefully noted here that whatever Radharani is doing is not to satisfy her or to satisfy other persons, her ultimate target is to satisfy Krishna and Krishna alone. Means is justified by the end.]

Where there is service there is no difficulty. Supreme Lord and His devotees both are worshipable. Worship means fulfilling the desires of the object of worship; I have no desire of my own. In this world it is the opposite; we have different desires so there is fight everywhere even in houses. There is fight between brother and brother, brother and sister, father and son, husband and wife etc. because of different demands and pride of being an enjoyer. So this world is a place of forest fire. There, in the spiritual world, there is no fire. Everyone see others as their worshipable. No one considers oneself as an enjoyer; getting service there brings happiness. Supreme Lord also serves devotees and devotees serve Him. Supreme Lord’s target is to give happiness to devotee and devotees target is to give happiness to the Lord, nothing for the self.

Sri Krishna comes back with cows and cowherd boys. Brahmaji says, “Though, we (demigods) are the presiding deities of the senses, we do not have transcendental eyes by which we can have darshan of Lord’s such pastimes. The cowherd boys and devotees have transcendental senses. Though, we do not have eligibility, even being falsely proud of being the presiding deities of the senses, we get enchanted and attracted just by Krishna’s walking there. So, what to say of happiness and bliss obtained by those who are personally present in the transcendental realm and are part of such pastimes?”

Krishna then meets Nanda Maharaj and Yashoda Devi and all others, also by seeing Radharani on the way Krishna is very pleased. Yashoda Devi out of affection embraces and cleanses Krishna. I remember such Krishna in the afternoon.
Lila Kirtan 5

articles.title: Sixth Yaam - Bhava
articles.author: Sree Chaitanya Gaudiya Math
articles.excerpt: 5:46pm to 8:10pm. Due to offences, our heart has become hard as a thunderbolt. There is no ecstatic transformations when I chant Your Name. O most merciful treasure house of compassion, give me a few drops of feeling for You and save my life.

blocks.text: Sixth Period of Devotional Practice (6th Yama Sadhana)
Evening Bhajan—Bhava (Prior stage of prema)
External symptoms of realized state

O Supreme Lord Sri Krishna! When by uttering your Holy Name, my eyes will be adorned with sacred glamour of the rolling down of tears, while uttering, my voice will be choked (will not be able to utter the complete Holy Name, words will be incoherent—not understandable to ordinary persons), the whole body will be horripilated (saturated with thrilling sensation).

I am not in that state now. When it will happen, I do not know. Dhruva Maharaj, crying out continuously, called out Supreme Lord. His mother, Suniti Devi, is vartma-pradarshak-guru — who showed him the path to get the grace of Supreme Lord. She instructed him before he had darshan of Narad Goswami. She told, “You will get Supreme Lord by calling out His Name; He will be pleased and you will get a kingdom greater than your father’s. So call out for the Lotus eyed Hari.”

Dhruva Maharaj took a vow that if Lord appears by repeatedly calling out His Name then only he will come back to his palace otherwise he will leave his body. Seeing him, his mother understood that he will perform devotion but she did not imagine that at the age of five he will leave the world to attain the Supreme Lord.

While instructing him, she cautioned him on one matter. We have to give utmost attention to this particular instruction given to him as we have got this human birth only for performing devotion to the Supreme Lord. And if we die without performing devotion then there is no guarantee that we get our next birth as a human. So we have to think very seriously on this instruction. She told, “I know that you will perform devotion. But you will attain perfection only if you practice devotion without keeping any hostile mentality towards anyone in this world.

There is most valuable and confidential teaching in this two lines. When Dhruva had seen his brother Uttam on the lap of his father, he desired to take the same position in his father’s lap but his step-mother spoke very harsh words to him. She said, “You run away from here; you do not have any right to take this position; your mother is most unfortunate”.

So mother Suniti instructed him, “If you perform devotion keeping anger to your step-mother or anybody else then you will not get eternal good”. Person like me always blame others. I think, “I am all right and all others have defects in them. How will tears come in my eyes? It is impossible. It will not happen merely by delivering a speech. Nobody can deceive God. Mother Suniti instructed Dhruva Maharaj, “Do not blame your step-mother for your afflictions; you would have given sufferings to others in the past as a result of which you are getting the same in return. Your step-mother is just the instrument, she is not the cause. Every living being reaps the fruits of his own action. Do not blame your father or anybody else also.”

If we keep blaming others for our sufferings then never we can think that we can get that ultimate goal, NEVER. It will not happen. One may say, “I have not done any harm to anyone then why am I getting the pain?”

We do not know about our previous lives but Supreme Lord knows everything. We may have done something in of our previous births the result of which we are getting in return. So it is advised to remove all the hostile mentality to anybody from our heart, not a cent of it should be there. If you have hostile mentality to anybody then you will not get rescued; you will not be successful.

Dhruva at once effaced all the hostile mentality from his heart for everyone. We cannot do this. We keep the hostile mentality life long, we cannot simply remove it. It is impossible, God is Omniscient; all knowing. No body can deceive Him. Person like me performing bhajan from past so many years but not a drop of water come out from my eyes. If anytime water is seen in the eyes, it could be because of some eye-disease. Why is water not coming out? It is because of my own offences. There is no love for Supreme Lord. And if you blame others then all your bhajan will be finished. Dhruva has got that power to accept those teachings. He removed all hostile mentality to anybody in this world and called out, “Where is my Lotus-eyed Hari? Where is my lotus-eyed Hari?” Continuously weeping with tears rolling down from his eyes, he called out the Supreme Lord and the Lord became satisfied. We have to understand this.
Chaitanya Mahaprabhu played the pastime of hearing life stories of Dhruva and Prahlad hundred times and requested Gadadhar Pandit to read it again and again. He is teaching us.

Oh Krishna! When by uttering Your Holy Name tears will roll down from my eyes, my voice will be choked and the whole body will horripilate? When? When this does not happen, one should understand that there must be some mistake on my part, definitely so. Supreme Lord is equal to one and all, there is no fault in Him. When will by taking the Holy Name my whole body will experience horripilation?

In his Kirtan, Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakur is mentioning about the eight principal ecstatic feelings. We have listened to the Kirtan many a times but have never deeply contemplated on its meaning. Only by offence-less chanting, we will experience these eight ecstatic symptoms.

lines: prema dhana binā vyārtha daridra jivana
dāsa kari vetana more deha premadhana

blocks.text: When pure love for Supreme Lord has not manifested, then what is the value of this devotional life? It is useless and futile. We ourselves are not happy and because of that we give distress to others. Kama, krodha, lobha, moha, mada, matsar are still present in our heart.
Make me your servant and if you want to pay me salary then award me the wealth of Divine Love. I do not pray for the worldly wealth.
Siksataka Kirtan 6

blocks.text: Radharani, sends the good preparations of food cooked by her in the afternoon for Krishna through one confidante (sakhi) to Nandagram in the evening. Sakhi brings those good preparations of food from Javat to Nandagram and offers to Yashoda Devi. Yashoda Devi feeds her child Krishna with great affection and satisfaction. After Krishna’s taking food, the remnant— Prasad, has been brought back by sakhi from Nandagram to Javat and is offered to Radharani. Radharani takes the remnant— Krishna’s Prasad, with great satisfaction. I remember such sweet pastimes of Radharani.

What is the evening pastime of Radharani? In the evening, whatever She had prepared with a great love in the afternoon for Krishna, various dishes like Karpurkeli, Amritakeli, etc., She sends it through one confidante (sakhi) from Javat to Nandagram. Javat is not so near to Nandagram, but in Dham everyone has transcendental body; they serve Krishna by that transcendental body. Even with this material body, in childhood, 70 years back, we used to walk a few miles to go to school. But these days, even walking for a mile is difficult for us. There has been a great change even in the ability of material bodies over a time. Comfort has been given prime importance these days so the habits have changed. It was not like this before. Mahaprabhu Himself had gone to Vrindavan from Jagannath Puri by foot. We need train travel, reserved berth, good facility for eating and drinking, and so many things to be arranged. So things have changed. A surrendered devotee performs all activities for the satisfaction of Krishna and Krishna protects him too.

Here, Sakhi walks from Javat to Nandagram singing the glories of RadhaKrishna. They are not seen so by singing Their glories she tries to reduce her distress. Thus by singing the glories of RadhaKrishna she walks the entire path. Radharani also remembers Krishna. Amongst all the sakhi, She chooses one sakhi who would take the prepared dishes by Her to Krishna. All the sakhi are very anxious to get the service. The sakhi who gets the service gets extremely delighted and blissful and others become morose on being deprived of service. Here in this world it is opposite, one who gets the service becomes unhappy thinking that he only is given service and others not. If someone says to us that you eat properly and take proper rest then we are happy. There in the transcendental world it is not like that. There, they become blissful on getting service.

The sakhi who got the service opportunity comes on the entire path, singing the glories of RadhaKrishna, experiencing the topmost bliss. On reaching Nandagram, she offers obeisance to Yashoda Devi and Nandababa. They both become blissful on seeing her. Nandababa asks her, “What have you brought?” And on listening that she has brought offerings for Krishna, Nandababa becomes more delighted.
The sakhi then tells them, “I am ordinary maid-servant. I am ordered by Radharani to do some service. Can I do some service here?”

She then gets blissful to get various services like washing vessels etc. While serving, washing vessels she gets the glimpse of Krishna. She gets great bliss just by the sight of Krishna, though she does not get to talk to Him. In this way she spent some time there. After Krishna’s taking food, she brings the remnant to Javat. On the way back also she keeps singing the glories of RadhaKrishna throughout. Radharani is waiting anxiously for her to come back. The sakhi then offers the Prasad to Radharani. Radharani takes the remnant—Krishna’s Prasad, with great satisfaction. I remember such sweet pastimes of Radharani.

What are Krishna’s pastime? Yashoda Devi bathes Krishna; by Krishna’s touch she feels happy. By serving Krishna who is All-auspicious, All-blissful, she get immersed in the ocean of happiness and bliss. There is immense happiness in service. Just by the sight of Yashoda, Krishna is happy. In this material world also we derive happiness by service. She bathes Krishna with great love, dresses Him in beautiful garments and adores Him. Shows great affection for the child, for He had taken so much trouble for grazing cows in the forest walking barefoot. Thinking His soft feet are paining after walking on stones and thorns whole day, she massages His feet and pacifies Him. Then asks Him to go to cowshed for milking the cows telling Him, “We are cowherd people, we sell milk and make a living”.
Krishna, “Mother, I will go right now”.

Taking His cowherd friends, He goes to the cowshed. There, the cows are thinking, “When Krishna will come, when Krishna will come”. Cows are extremely happy to see Krishna and out of spontaneous love, they starts giving milk automatically. The cows are always ready to serve Krishna. Krishna returns to the house and gladly takes the food prepared by Radharani with love sent through the sakhi. I remember such sweet pastimes of Krishna in the evening with great adoration.
Lila Kirtan 6

articles.excerpt: 8:10pm to 10:34pm. Symptoms of separation grief— even a moment’s separation from Govinda will be considered as an epoch, tears will roll down from the eyes like rainfall, realization of the voidness of the whole world.

Devotional spiritual practice at Dusk ‘Prema’—Divine Love in separation
7th Verse of Sri Shikshastaka Internal symptoms of realized state or highest objective—‘Premabhakti’
Symptoms of separation grief—even a moment’s separation from Govinda will be considered as an epoch, tears will roll down from the eyes like rainfall, realization of the voidness of the whole world.

Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakur’s writing: Due to separation grief, these symptoms will be manifested— every day is spent with anxiety, one moment of separation is equal to an epoch, tears are rolling down from the eyes like the clouds of rainy season, voidness of three worlds, due to extreme separation grief from Govinda burning sensation like inextinguishable fire made with husk yet life is not collapsing.

When there is actual separation grief from Govinda, even a moment will seem equal to an epoch. When there is that sort of indifference to the worldly things of the world, there is no question of taking all these prohibited things, one will give up even the good vegetables which are not prohibited to eat. As separation grief will be immense one will give up everything like Raghunath Das Goswami and others.
Siksataka Kirtan 7

blocks.text: Indication of pastimes of RadhaKrishna at dusk

lines: kṛṣṇaṁ gopaiḥ sabhāyāṁ vihita-guṇi kalālokanaṁ snigdha mātrā
yatnādānīya saṁśāyitam atha nibhṛtaṁ prāpta-kuṣjaṁ smarāmi

blocks.text: Srimati Radhika, as per advice of Vrinda Devi, at dusk wearing garments of black and white colour, suitable to dark fortnight and bright fortnight respectively (with the desire to hide herself from the detection of others), in the company of sakhis (confidantes), with female messenger (gopi), goes to Sanket Kunja (particular suggested grove) under wish-yielding tree, saturated by beautiful sacred surroundings at the bank of the Yamuna to meet beloved Krishna at the appointed time and place.

On the other side, Krishna’s pastimes at dusk—Krishna has satisfied all His personal associates except gopas (milkmen). The gopas are disheartened not to get scope to serve Krishna, but as Sri Krishna is Omniscient, He knows the minds of the milkmen. When milkmen want to exhibit some interesting games and sports with skillfulness and Krishna is invited to come to the special meeting place to see the sports, Krishna immediately accepts the proposal and goes to the meeting place to see nice skillfulness of the gopas and the sports and wrestling activities. Krishna is so much attracted by seeing the sports, He is requesting to demonstrate different sports, one after another. Affectionate mother Yashoda Devi is very much worried on seeing the son not coming from the meeting and going to bed. Yashoda Devi is repeatedly calling the son for going to bed to sleep, but the son is not coming. Such is the nature of restless children. Yashoda Devi goes herself to ‘Krishna’ to pacify the child and to ask the wrestlers to stop showing wrestling and their skillfulness. She brings the child to bed and sings songs to make the child sleep. When Krishna has sound sleep, Nanda Maharaj and Yashoda Devi are happy. They also go to bed for sleep but what happens—Krishna being attracted by pure devotion of Radha, secretly leaves the bed and goes to Sanket Kunja (the said particular grove) to meet Radharani at dusk. I remember such Radha and Krishna.

We are not eligible to think about this now. When we shall have tears rolling down like rainfall and the whole world feels void, then we are entitled to contemplate on this pastime otherwise not. At first our Param Gurudeva introduced remembering Shikshastaka only in the Kartika-vrata and not the pastimes. Afterwards remembering of the pastimes has been introduced. Our Guruvarga have introduced this so that we have some sort of inquisitiveness; some sort of longing and desire to know about the transcendental realm. If anybody hankers and has extreme longing to get the eligibility then remembering these pastimes will take him to that place. For that reason this has been introduced. But we are not eligible now. At present, we do not think that our house is nothing or our family is nothing. We do not have the separation grief.
Lila Kirtan 7

Jewel amongst all beloved gopis Srimati Radhika’s apophthegm—Sri Krishna can crush this maid servant, devoted to His Lotus Feet, by firmly embracing me or mortifying me anywhere and everywhere by His profligate behavior with any of His beloved gopis, yet He is my dearest beloved and nobody else. In this context, it will be relevant to go through one verse of Sri Chaitanya Charitamrita (Antya lila 20/52), written by Srila Krishnadas Kaviraj Goswami:

lines: nā gaṇi āpana dukha, sabe vāñchi tāra sukha,

blocks.text: Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, accepting the mode of worship and form of Radharani, with extreme separation grief, has stated thus—Radharani’s apophthegm. Only Radharani can speak like this—“I do not consider my own grief, I only want His contentment, my purpose is His satisfaction. If by giving suffering to me, He becomes very happy, that distress to me will be my highest contentment.” Nobody on earth can inflict suffering to any person who is well-established in such thought or at least sincerely endeavoring to attain such state of mind.

blocks.text: Indication of night pastimes of RadhaKrishna

Only dearest confidantes are entitled to enter into the night pastimes of RadhaKrishna. Sakhis always try for the union of RadhaKrishna. Actually, RadhaKrishna are very much eager for mutual union at night. When RadhaKrishna’s union is manifested, Vrinda Devi with dearest sakhis worship RadhaKrishna in various ways. After that RadhaKrishna with those sakhis move in the forest, sing songs, do Rasalila with dancing etc. When RadhaKrishna, by doing so much pastimes become extremely fatigued, most beloved sakhis serve them nicely and at the end, make nice bed with flowers where RadhaKrishna make the pastimes of sleep. I remember such sweet pastimes of RadhaKrishna.
Our Revered Guruvargas used to caution us by saying—only eligible votaries can remember the pastimes of RadhaKrishna of mid-day at Radhakunda, dusk pastimes and night pastimes of Rasalila.
Lila Kirtan 8

articles.title: Sri Damodarastakam
articles.author: Sree Bhakti Saurabh Acharya Maharaj
articles.excerpt: Satyavrata Muni has sung in adoration the glories of Lord Damodar (Krishna with corded belly) in eight verses which we recite daily during the Kartik-vrata. (Found in Padma Purana, author: Sri Krishna Dvaipayan Veda Vyasa Muni)

blocks.text: I lie prostrate in obeisance to the Lotus Feet of Supreme Lord ‘Damodar’ [Damodar—Krishna with corded belly], Who is Eternal-Omniscient-Ever Blissful, Whose earring is constantly swinging, Who is the glowing Beauty of Gokul, Who after stealing cream, out of fear of being apprehended by mother ‘Yasoda’, leaped from mortar and fled. Mother Yasoda seeing this followed the child very speedily and caught hold of His back.

Apprehending of being beaten by mother, child Krishna is crying and rubbing His two eyes again and again, Who is looking with panic, Whose neck is adorned with three charming thin lines created by repeated breathing and shivering and due to that Whose golden necklace is oscillating, Whose belly is fastened by mother Yasoda with rope, I sing the wonderful glories of Sri Damodar, Who is bound by pure devotion.

I, again, in loving devotion sing in adoration of the Lotus Feet of Supreme Lord Damodar by hundreds of hymns because Sri Damodar has immersed all residents of Gokul in the holy charming pond of boyhood pastimes and He has proclaimed to the devotees performing reverential worship that He can be only conquered by sweet devotion of Vraja-dham, emanating from intimate delightful relation.

lines: varaṁ deva mokṣaṁ na mokṣāvadhiṁ vā
sadā me manasy āvirāstāṁ kim anyaiḥ

blocks.text: O beloved God (devoted to childhood sweet pastimes)! Although you are competent to bestow all kinds of boons, I do not want from you chaturtha varga—fourth pursuit-salvation, even beyond salvation I do not want condensed bliss of Vaikuntha. I do not ask for any other boon. O Lord! I only want eternal appearance of your sweet childhood Form ‘Gopal’ in my heart and nothing else.

O Lord! May your beautiful lotus face enclosed by dark blue and pleasant crimson colour hairs and your red lips similar to ‘bimba’ fruit (red colour fruit) kissed repeatedly by mother Yasoda, appear in my heart. I do not need to get millions of other attainments.

O God! O Damodar! O Unlimited! O Overlord! I bow down in obeisance to your Lotus Feet. Kindly be gracious to me as I am submerged in the ocean of series of sufferings due to my aversion to you. Please rescue me—a wretched soul, from the aforesaid severe suffering by showering your compassionate glance and appear before me with your natural sweet Form.

O Damodar! You accepted mother’s tie of affection—your fastening with the mortar and made the pastimes of liberating deserving persona Nalakuver and Manigriv, sons of Sri Kuver and bestow bhakti upon them. In a like manner, kindly give me the same Prembhakti. I do not aspire for salvation like Nalakuver and Manigriv. (I want only pure devotion to you to engage me completely in your service.)

O Damodar! I bow with devoutness to the blooming bright fastening cord of your belly. After that I also make my humble obeisance to your belly as receptacle of the whole universe (Brahmanda). I make prostrated obeisances to your dearest consort Srimati Radhika and also to you—Supreme Lord, endowed with the opulence of making infinite pastimes.

articles.title: Introduction to Śrī Bhajan-Rahasya’
articles.author: Sreemad Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati Goswami Thakura Prabhupad
articles.excerpt: Introduction to Śrī Bhajan-Rahasya 'Śrī Bhajan-Rahasya'—Book is compiled by Revered Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakur. He has shown a few hints about his own mode of worship in the form of a book as an instance to his own devoted followers. The introduction of this book is written by Srila Bhaktisiddhant Saraswati Thakur Prabhupad.

blocks.text: Rahasyer Prāgbandha
[Prior obligatory regulation for being eligible to realize ontological mystery of Bhajan]

‘Śrī Bhajan-Rahasya’— Book is compiled by Revered Śrila Bhaktivinode Thākur. He has shown a few hints about his own mode of worship in the form of a book as an instance to his own devoted followers. I, being an insignificant person, observed him a few years before, overwhelmed with Transcendental Divine Love while relishing several scriptural verses incessantly in this way.

[There are stages of advancement of pure devotion— First stage— ‘Kaniṣṭha’, second higher stage—‘Madhyam’ (middle) and third highest stage— ‘Uttam’. Accurate understanding of the words ‘Kaniṣṭha’, ‘Madhyam’ and ‘Uttam’ is necessary for proper realization of the ontological mystery of Bhajan as expounded or interpreted by Srila Bhakti Siddhanta Saraswati Goswāmi Thākur.]

Provision for ‘Arcan’— Worship of Deities is recommended in the domain of pure devotion in consideration of the eligibility of the devoutness of ‘Kaniṣṭha devotee’— first advanced stage of devotion. Many votaries being unable to reflect upon the distinction between ‘Arcan’ and ‘Bhajan’ indicate the words to be same, as ‘Arcan’ is ‘Bhajan’. When bhajan is possible on the basis of nine forms of devotion, as ‘Arcan’ is included within it, ‘Arcan’ should be accepted as ‘Bhajan’, that is their idea. Total bhajan and practice of one form of bhajan, at least of the aforesaid first advanced stage of devotion, should not be considered to indicate the same significance.

There are two kinds of worship— (1) Worship of Deities with the help of articles and with reverence is ‘Arcan’. (2) Service of the object of worship with the feeling of eternal sweet delightful relation, viz. delightful relation between devotee and devoted as bosom friends, sweet parental affection without the obstruction of fear and reverence etc. are referred to as ‘Prema’. There is a gulf of difference between these two ways of service of the Object of worship. Arcan is connected with the worship of Deity with reverence. Without sweet delightful eternal relation, there cannot be total service of the Highest Objective Supreme Lord.

Worship of Deity—Supreme Lord in consideration of His appearance in this world, with articles and reverence is termed ‘Arcan’. Although in spite of the cognition of the dimness of the scorching rays of reverential majestic worship in this world, excellence of the sweetness of the service of the Deity with delightful charming love-relation like pleasant moonlight, cannot be denied. A brief method of worship (Arcan) is annexed to the appendix of the book. The underlying implication of bhajan is stated in the body of the book. Relation with gross and subtle bodies is more or less involved in ‘Arcan’, while in the domain of bhajan, the devotee is directly in contact with the object of devotion Supreme Lord Bhagavān, Who is beyond gross and subtle bodies and is the Indwelling Monitor residing in the hearts of all embodied souls. A true devoted soul is well-established in his real self and is completely liberated from all non-eternal material denominations, his cognitions of the sense-organs are spiritual, beyond the thought of material range. As they are always directly in contact with Absolute Knowledge, Who is Transcendental, they are always engaged in transcendental service of the Divinity. Speciality of the instructive object of Guru is considered Rahasya (Mystery) which can only be comprehended by persons who have got firm faith and confidence.

Truly following the path of bona fide sādhus, association of whom can be achieved only by the fruits of serving the third advanced stage of highest devotees, who have received instructions of Krishna-bhakti after practising the list of Sādhan-bhakti, mentioned in ‘Śrī Bhakti-Rasāmṛta-Sindhu’, is actual Bhajan-Rahasya (mystery of bhajan). Desireless modest devout devotee, being fully liberated from worldly entanglement, is completely released from the association of uncongenial persons disinclined to serve Krishna and entrapped with ulterior desires. Just then only, total service or service of eight periods of the pastimes of Śrī Krishna can be manifested in him. Pure devotee who is inclined to serve Śrī Krishna always dislikes the association of enjoyers of earthly pleasures (Bhogis) and renouncers (Tyagis), as he knows the association of such non-devotees is an obstacle to the achievement of his objective. Such ‘Karmīs’, ‘Jṣānīs’ or persons of ulterior desires have got no liking for Bhajan-Rahasya. As they have got no eligibility to enter into the eight periods of pastimes of Śrī Krishna in the Transcendental Realm, this book (Bhajan-Rahasya) cannot become always very appreciative to them.

Day and night (24 hours) is divided into eight periods. One period is stated as ‘Yam’. Night consists of three yams (three periods), day consists of three yams (three periods), along with these six periods, if ‘dawn’ and ‘dusk’ are added, sum total— 8 periods.

It is possible only for a Vaiṣṇava to worship Śrī Krishna all the time in all respects with profound devoutness. With wrong conception of self, other than the real self eternally related to Śrī Krishna, it is not possible to worship Krishna all the time. A conditioned soul cannot release him from his encagement if he attributes materiality to all things or articles related to the service of Śrī Krishna. Vaiṣṇavas having the firmness of the realization of their real self are always in worshipful mood. They cannot do any action except service of Śrī Krishna. Eight verses of Śikṣāṣṭaka of Śrī Gaurāṅga Mahāprabhu are in conformity with the pastimes of Śrī Krishna of the eight periods (Aṣṭayāma). Eleven verses of Sri Rūpa Goswāmi and hymns written by his personal associates to increase eagerness of Bhajan, conforming to eight pastimes will be congenial for incessant Bhajan. Sincere servitors of Guru will always discuss these verses, being completely relieved from the influence of material time, space, and so called deserving or undeserving persons of the world.

Kanpur

Harijanakinkar,

13th Nov, 1927

(servant of the associates of Śrī Hari)

Das Sri Bhakti Siddhanta Saraswati
